battle.name: 抗日戰爭
battle.brief: 1937年7月7日盧溝橋事變引爆全面戰爭，至1945年9月2日《日本投降書》簽署為止，國民政府與日本帝國在華北、華中、華南全面對抗，正面戰場與敵後游擊並行。卡面的1840年法國雷管步槍未實際參戰，其雷管擊發與膛線米涅彈開創的散兵線精確射擊，才是本役中日雙方步槍戰術的共同源頭。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 這場戰爭是中國與日本之間自1937年7月7日盧溝橋事變起、至1945年9月2日《日本投降書》簽署為止的全面戰爭，交戰主體分別是國民政府領導的中國與日本帝國。中國一方以軍事委員會為最高軍事統帥機關，蔣中正任委員長，軍令部由徐永昌主持承辦軍令，參謀總部籌劃作戰，戰區制與集團軍制並行：正面戰場先後劃分津浦、察哈爾、冀魯豫、晉綏、山東、河南等戰區，李宗仁以第五戰區司令官指揮徐州會戰，傅作義出任第六戰區司令官經營綏遠與太原防務，第九戰區由薛岳接掌，負責武漢、南昌與長沙一帶；1938年武漢會戰時中國方面投入兵力逾百萬，是正面戰場規模最大的一次會戰。敵後戰場則由中國共產黨領導的紅軍改編為國民革命軍第八路軍（115師林彪、120師賀龍、129師劉伯承）與新編第四軍，在華北與華中開闢抗日根據地，實行游擊戰與根據地建設。日本一方自1937年8月擴大戰爭後，陸軍以師團為基本戰鬥單位，關東軍經營滿洲，1939年3月正式編成中國派遣軍，以西原征內為首任司令官，統合關內外日軍，推行以戰略要地為中心的分進合擊。第三方方面，蘇聯自1937年底派遣空軍志願隊援華並提供軍援，英美在珍珠港事件後於1941年12月正式對日開戰，1942年1月《聯合國宣言》使中國成為同盟國四強之一，1943年11月開羅會議與1945年6月舊金山會議確定了中國的戰後地位。
countriesEn: This war was the total conflict between China and Japan that ran from the Marco Polo Bridge Incident of 7 July 1937 to the signing of the Instrument of Surrender of Japan on 2 September 1945; the principal belligerents were the China led by the Nationalist government and the Empire of Japan. On the Chinese side the highest military command organ was the Military Affairs Commission, chaired by Chiang Kai-shek, with the General Staff Department issuing orders under War Minister Hsu Yung-chang and the General Staff Headquarters planning operations; the zone system and the army group system existed in parallel. The frontal theatre was divided in turn into the Tsinpu, Chahar, Hopei-Shantung-Henan, Suiyuan, Shantung and Honan war zones. Li Tsung-ien commanded the fifth war zone through the Hsuchow campaign, Fu Zuoyi took the sixth war zone and handled Suiyuan and the Taiyuan defence, and Hsueh Yue took over the ninth war zone with responsibility for Wuhan, Nanchang and Changsha. At the Wuhan campaign of 1938 China committed more than a million men, making it the largest battle on the frontal front. On the rear front the Red Army reorganised under Chinese Communist leadership as the Eighth Route Army (115th Division under Lin Biao, 120th Division under He Long, 129th Division under Liu Bocheng) and the New Fourth Army, and opened anti-Japanese base areas in North and Central China for guerrilla warfare and base-area construction. On the Japanese side the army fought with divisions as its basic tactical unit; the Kwantung Army administered Manchuria, and in March 1939 the China Expeditionary Army was formally organised with Nishijiro Nishihara as its first commander, integrating the Japanese forces inside and outside the Great Wall and pursuing divide-and-converge attacks centred on operational key points. As third parties, the Soviet Union sent air force volunteers to China from late 1937 and supplied military aid, while Britain and the United States, after the attack on Pearl Harbor, formally entered the war against Japan in December 1941; the Declaration by United Nations of 1 January 1942 made China one of the four great Allied powers, and the Cairo Conference of November 1943 and the San Francisco Conference of June 1945 fixed China's postwar position.
people: 關鍵人物橫跨兩條戰線。中國方面，蔣中正自1937年7月17日廬山談話起表明守土抗戰之責，9月23日發表告全國民眾書正式對日宣戰，1943年11月出席開羅會議，1945年9月9日在南京主持中國戰區受降典禮；徐永昌以軍令部長主持軍令業務，陳誠、熊斌先後出任參謀總長。戰場上，第五戰區司令官李宗仁統籌徐州會戰，第31師師長池峰城與第2集團軍總司令孫連仲在台兒莊正面死守，第20集團軍總司令湯恩伯自側後迂迴，第5戰區騎兵第2軍自側翼掩護，配合1938年3月23日夜襲奪回台兒莊；薛岳以第九戰區司令官指揮南昌、瑞昌、萬家嶺與三次長沙會戰，第33集團軍總司令張自忠於1940年5月16日在湖北宜城殉國。敵後方面，毛澤東提出獨立自主的山地游擊戰方針，1938年5月發表《論持久戰》，把戰爭劃為戰略防禦、戰略相持、戰略反攻三個階段，朱德任八路軍總司令、彭德懷任副總司令，1940年8月發動百團大戰，劉伯承率129師與陳賡386旅在娘子關、神頭嶺一帶破襲正太路。日本方面，近衛文麿內閣1937年7月聲明不以國民政府為對象，同年12月承認偽滿洲國，1938年12月下台；畑俊六自1938年11月出任中國派遣軍司令官，岡村寧次1944年8月接任中國派遣軍總司令並於1945年8月代表日軍在南京投降；東條英機1941年12月組閣推行以戰養戰；汪精衛1940年3月在南京成立傀儡政權，1945年日本投降後潛逃。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities span both fronts. On the Chinese side Chiang Kai-shek, from the Lushan address of 17 July 1937 onward, declared the duty to resist to the last, issued the address to the whole nation on 23 September formally declaring war on Japan, attended the Cairo Conference in November 1943, and presided over the Chinese Theatre surrender ceremony in Nanjing on 9 September 1945. Hsu Yung-chang ran the war order business as War Minister, with Chen Cheng and Hsiong Ping successively serving as chief of the General Staff. On the battlefield Li Tsung-ien, commander of the fifth war zone, directed the Hsuchow campaign; the 31st Division under Chi Feng-ch'eng and the 2nd Army Group under Sun Lien-chung held the frontal position at Taierzhuang, while the 20th Army Group under Tang En-po wheeled in from the flank and the 2nd Cavalry Army of the fifth war zone screened the movement, together with the night attack of 23 March 1938 that retook Taierzhuang. Hsueh Yue, commander of the ninth war zone, directed the fighting at Nanchang, Ruichang, Wanjialing and the three battles of Changsha, and Chang Chih-chung, commander of the 33rd Army Group, was killed in action at Yicheng in Hubei on 16 May 1940. On the rear front Mao Tse-tung advanced the line of independent and self-reliant guerrilla warfare in the mountains and published On Protracted War in May 1938, dividing the war into stages of strategic defence, strategic stalemate and strategic counter-offensive; Chu Teh commanded the Eighth Route Army with Peng Teh-huai as deputy, and in August 1940 they launched the Hundred Regiments Offensive, Liu Po-ch'eng's 129th Division and Chen Geng's 386th Brigade breaking the Pingyang railway around Niangziguan and Shentouling. On the Japanese side the Konoe cabinet declared in July 1937 that it did not regard the Nationalist government as its object, recognised the puppet state of Manchukuo in December of the same year, and fell in December 1938; Hata Shunroku became commander of the China Expeditionary Army in November 1938, Okamura Yasuji took over as its commander in August 1944 and surrendered on behalf of the Japanese forces in Nanjing in August 1945; Hideki Tojo formed his cabinet in December 1941 and pursued a war of self-sufficiency; and Wang Jingwei set up a puppet regime in Nanjing in March 1940, fleeing after Japan's surrender in 1945.
kits: 卡面上的1840年法國雷管步槍並未出現在本役戰場，它是近代栓動步槍的技術祖型，其血脈可以一路追到抗日戰爭中真正開火的中日兩軍步槍。1840年法國步槍採用雷管擊發與膛線米涅式彈，把有效射程推到二百米以上，步兵於是由密集縱隊散成散兵線，精確瞄準射擊成為基本動作。抗日戰爭中，中軍以漢陽兵工廠仿製德國一八八八年式步槍（俗稱漢陽造）為主，配中正式（仿德造）、德制九八年式毛瑟，以及後期美援的M1加蘭特與卡賓槍，口徑七九、六五與七六毫米混雜，補充線極不穩定；日軍以三八式有坂（6.5毫米）步槍為主，配三九式、七九式，另發放九八式補充槍，壽命長、精度佳，被譽為百年不用修的槍。機槍方面，中軍有仿捷克的國產輕機槍、仿德MG08的二四式重機槍與美援勃朗寧一九一七式、一九一九式，日軍有十一式輕機槍與九二式重機槍。火炮方面，中軍以八二迫擊炮與六七式山炮為主，重炮極少，早期僅有德制一五五厘山炮與英製七五厘山炮；日軍配九七式八九厘迫擊炮、七五厘野戰炮與一二式一二厘野戰炮，並大量使用八八式與一〇〇式擲彈筒。運輸與補給初靠騾馬、黃牛與擔夫，公路鐵路遭破壞後極為吃力，1941年後美援卡車與汽油大量進入，遠征軍在滇緬公路仍以人背馬馱為主。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle of 1840 shown on the card never appeared on this battlefield; it is the technical ancestor of the modern bolt-action rifle, and its lineage can be traced straight to the rifles that actually fired in the war in China and in Japan. The French musket of 1840 used a percussion cap and the rifled Minié ball, pushing effective range beyond two hundred metres, so infantry broke out of dense columns into skirmisher lines and aimed individual fire became the basic action. In the war the Nationalist army relied mainly on the Hanyang Arsenal copy of the German Model 1888 rifle, commonly called the Hanyang rifle, together with the locally made Chung-cheng rifle, the German Model 98 Mauser, and later American M1 Garands and M1 carbines; calibres of 7.92, 6.5 and 7.62 millimetres were mixed, and the replacement chain was highly unstable. The Japanese army centred on the Type 38 Arisaka rifle in 6.5 calibre, with the Type 39 and Type 89 rifles and Type 98 carbines issued alongside; they were long-lived and accurate and were praised as rifles needing no repair for a century. On the machine gun side China had a locally built light machine gun copied from the Czech ZB-26, the Model 24 heavy machine gun copied from the German MG08, and American Browning Model 1917 and Model 1919 guns, while Japan fielded the Type 11 light machine gun and the Type 92 heavy machine gun. In artillery China relied on 82 millimetre mortars and Type 67 mountain guns with very few heavy pieces, the early stocks being limited to German 155 millimetre mountain guns and British 75 millimetre mountain guns; Japan brought up the Type 97 89 millimetre mortar, 75 millimetre field guns and the Type 12 120 millimetre field gun, and used the Type 88 and Type 100 grenade launchers in quantity. Transport and supply at first depended on mules, oxen and human carriers, and became desperately hard once roads and railways were cut; American trucks and fuel flooded in after 1941, while the China Expeditionary Force on the Burma road still depended on porters and pack animals.
tactics: 抗戰初期延續北洋以來的散兵線與火力集中：正面戰場以德制教範為基礎，中軍常採兩線作戰，第一線以步槍、手榴彈與機槍構成散兵線，後方預備隊與迫擊炮群跟進；日軍以分進合擊企圖在作戰正面形成包圍，總攻前以短兵密集衝鋒，屢以刺刀與擲彈筒解決被機槍封鎖的地段。會戰層面上，淞滬會戰以黃浦江沿岸及北南火車站、吳淞、羅店、大場為爭奪焦點，國軍以逐次抵抗消耗日軍；太原會戰的忻口正面陣地寬約十公里，日軍板垣師團夜襲娘子關得手，側面迂迴遂致全線動搖；徐州會戰在津浦、隴海鐵路交叉地帶收縮成台兒莊正面數公里，國軍以密集火力與反擊迫日軍後退。敵後戰場採取游擊戰與運動戰配合：八路軍、新四軍破襲交通、伏擊據點、轉入山區，以三三制的地方武裝配合正規軍；1940年百團大戰同時破襲正太鐵路與平漢、同蒲路，以夜行軍集中兵力逐段破壞路基、鐵軌與橋樑，切斷日軍以鐵路為柱、公路為鏈、據點為鎖的囚籠政策；1943年起根據地以大生產運動、減租減息與三三制鞏固，配合盟軍在緬北反攻。空戰方面，1940年後國軍由驅逐敵機為主改為游擊消耗敵空軍，美軍第十四航空隊在陳納德指揮下自雲南基地起飛作戰，並支援B-29自印度基地轟炸日本本土。
tacticsEn: The opening phase continued the skirmisher line and concentration of fire inherited from the Beiyang armies: on the frontal front the Chinese fought on two lines, the first being a skirmisher line of rifles, grenades and machine guns with reserve troops and mortar groups following, while the Japanese sought to envelop on the front of action and, before the general assault, used close-packed charges to break ground sealed off by machine gun fire, solving such sectors with the bayonet and the grenade launcher. At the level of battles, the Shanghai campaign fought over the Huangpu River and the north and south railway stations, Wusong, Luodian and Dachang, with the Chinese trading ground step by step to wear down the Japanese; at Taiyuan the frontal position at Xinkou was about ten kilometres wide, and the night seizure of Niangziguan by the Japanese Itagaki Division opened the way for a flanking movement that shook the whole line; in the Hsuchow campaign the fighting contracted at the junction of the Tsinpu and Lunghai railways into a few kilometres of front at Taierzhuang, where dense fire and counter-attacks pushed the Japanese back. On the rear front guerrilla warfare was combined with mobile warfare: the Eighth Route Army and the New Fourth Army cut transport lines, ambushed strongpoints and withdrew into the hills, with local armed units organised on the three-thirds system supporting the regular army. In the Hundred Regiments Offensive of 1940 the Pingyang railway and the Pinghan and Tungpu lines were cut simultaneously, night columns concentrating on segment after segment of trackbed, rail and bridge to sever the Japanese pillar-and-chain system of railways, roads and strongpoints; from 1943 the base areas were consolidated by the great production movement, rent and interest reduction, and the three-thirds system, supporting the Allied counter-offensive in northern Burma. In the air, after 1940 the Chinese air force changed from chasing Japanese aircraft to wearing them down by guerrilla action, and the American Fourteenth Air Force flew from bases in Yunnan under Chennault, supporting B-29 raids on the Japanese home islands from bases in India.
data: 可核的數字分兩邊看，差距極大。時間上，自1937年7月7日盧溝橋事變至1945年9月2日《日本投降書》簽署為八年又兩個月，加上一九三一年九一八事變後的局部抗戰，官方口徑常稱十四年抗戰。中國方面，國民政府抗戰期間先後徵兵逾一千四百萬，部隊傷亡一般引述約三百五十萬上下，各方統計口徑分歧甚大；日軍在中國戰場的損失數字，中方與日方戰史相差數倍。會戰規模上，淞滬會戰歷時三個月，國軍先後投入七十餘萬，日軍逐步增至三十萬上下，國軍傷亡失散約二十五至三十萬，日方記錄日軍傷亡約四萬，中方戰報則在六萬以上；太原忻口一役國軍傷亡以萬計；徐州會戰國軍集中約四十五個師、兵力約四十餘萬，對面日軍約四個師團、不足二十萬，台兒莊一役國軍戰報稱殲敵一萬餘，俘虜亦達一萬餘，日方記載遠低於此；武漢會戰歷時約四個半月，國軍投入逾百萬，日軍約三十五萬。外援方面，蘇聯在1937至1941年間交付中國飛機六百餘架（含教練機）、步槍兩萬支以上、機槍一千五百挺上下；美軍在租借法案下向中國交付軍火以億美元計，M1加蘭特步槍逾十五萬挺，各式飛機逾千架，卡車數萬輛。1945年8月蘇聯對日宣戰後出兵中國東北，關東軍崩潰，蘇軍俘獲日軍逾五十萬。
dataEn: The verifiable figures look very different depending on which side is counted. On duration, from the Marco Polo Bridge Incident of 7 July 1937 to the signing of the Japanese Instrument of Surrender on 2 September 1945 is eight years and two months; adding the partial resistance that began with the Mukden Incident of 1931, the official Chinese reckoning is the fourteen years of resistance. On the Chinese side the Nationalist government raised more than fourteen million men during the war, and total casualties among the troops are generally put at around three and a half million, though the counting methods of different sources differ widely; for Japanese losses in the Chinese theatre the Chinese figures and the Japanese official war histories differ by a factor of several. On the scale of battles, the Shanghai campaign lasted three months; China fed in more than seven hundred thousand men while the Japanese strength rose to around three hundred thousand, and Chinese casualties from wounds and disappearance are given at roughly two hundred and fifty to three hundred thousand. Japanese records put their own losses at about forty thousand, while Chinese reports claim more than sixty thousand. At Xinkou in the Taiyuan campaign Chinese casualties ran into the tens of thousands. In the Hsuchow campaign China concentrated about forty-five divisions, some four hundred thousand men, against roughly four Japanese divisions of fewer than two hundred thousand, and at Taierzhuang the Chinese report claimed over ten thousand Japanese killed and more than ten thousand prisoners taken, figures the Japanese records put far lower. The Wuhan campaign lasted about four and a half months, with more than a million Chinese and around three hundred and fifty thousand Japanese committed. As to foreign aid, the Soviet Union delivered to China more than six hundred aircraft including trainers, over twenty thousand rifles and about one thousand five hundred machine guns between 1937 and 1941; under the Lend-Lease Act the United States supplied China with materiel valued in the hundreds of millions of dollars, over one hundred and fifty thousand M1 Garand rifles, more than a thousand aircraft of assorted types and tens of thousands of trucks. After the Soviet declaration of war in August 1945 and its entry into Manchuria, the Kwantung Army collapsed and Soviet forces took more than five hundred thousand Japanese soldiers prisoner.
cause: 遠因是1929年大蕭條之後日本軍國主義的膨脹。日本資源貧乏，軍閥與財閥需要東北的煤鐵、滿洲的農產與遠東的市場，1931年9月18日關東軍炸毀南滿鐵路、攻佔瀋陽，扶植溥儀於1932年3月成立滿洲國，中國軍隊退出東北大部；同月一二八事變在上海引發抵抗，關東軍進攻熱河與長城各口，國民政府被迫簽訂《塘沽協約》與《何梅協定》，華北政治漸漸脫離中央控制，1935年底更出現學生一二九遊行與華北自治運動。近因是西安事變：1936年12月12日張學良、楊虎城扣留蔣中正，要求停止內戰、一致抗日，經周恩來居間斡旋和平解決，此後全國才逐步轉向抗戰。同時蘇聯在肅清托洛茨基派後削弱遠東力量，美國孤立主義與歐洲姑息使國際聯盟對日本無效，義大利與德國相繼侵略外國，軸心格局正在形成。1937年上半年，華北駐軍的爭端與地盤交易並行，日本內閣決定把北支事變擴大為全面戰爭，7月7日夜盧溝橋的槍聲最終引爆八年全面戰爭。
causeEn: The remote cause was the swelling of Japanese militarism after the Great Depression of 1929. Lacking resources at home, the military cliques and the zaibatsu wanted the coal and iron of Manchuria, the produce of Manchukuo and the markets of the Far East; on 18 September 1931 the Kwantung Army blew up the South Manchurian Railway, seized Mukden and set up Puyi as head of a Manchukuo state in March 1932, and Chinese forces withdrew from most of north-east China. The January 28 Incident brought resistance in Shanghai, the Kwantung Army drove into Rehe and the Great Wall passes, and the Nationalist government was forced into the Tanggu Agreement and the Ho-Umezu Agreement, so that politics in North China gradually slipped out of central control, and the student movement of 9 December 1935 and the North China autonomy campaign followed. The proximate cause was the Xi'an Incident: on 12 December 1936 Zhang Xueliang and Yang Hucheng detained Chiang Kai-shek and demanded an end to civil war and a united stand against Japan, and after Zhou Enlai acted as mediator and the matter was settled peacefully the whole country gradually turned to resistance. At the same time Soviet strength in the Far East was weakened by the purge of the Trotskyists, American isolationism and European appeasement left the League of Nations ineffective against Japan, and Italy and Germany were invading other countries, so an Axis alignment was taking shape. During the first half of 1937 disputes over the North China garrison ran alongside deals over spheres of influence, and the Japanese cabinet decided to turn the North China incident into a general war; the gunfire at Lugouqiao on the night of 7 July finally detonated eight years of full-scale war.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果遠超出戰場本身。中國方面，抗日戰爭第一次使中國在全國性戰爭中取得完全勝利，國家獨立的軍事基礎由此奠定；1943年1月中國與英美簽訂新約廢除治外特權，1945年中國成為聯合國創始會員國與安理會常任理事國，國際地位為百年來最高。經濟上，工廠內遷與淪陷區的破壞使全國工業化再度延後，戰後通貨膨脹惡化、接收區混亂，國共合作破裂後全面內戰爆發，國家再次陷入長期戰爭。台灣的問題也在此際解決：1943年開羅宣言明確台灣澎湖歸還中國，1945年10月25日台灣光復，陳儀主持接收，日治五十年留下的警察制度與土地問題隨後引發1947年二二事件。世界局勢上，中國的持久抗戰是同盟國取得太平洋戰爭勝利的重要支柱，日本投降後由盟軍主要由美國佔領，東亞秩序重組，越南、印尼等殖民地的民族解放運動隨之加速。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reached far beyond the battlefield. For China, the war was the first national war in which the country achieved a complete victory, and the military foundation of national independence was laid. In January 1943 China concluded new treaties with Britain and the United States abolishing extraterritorial privileges, and in 1945 it became a founding member of the United Nations and a permanent member of the Security Council, its international standing reaching the highest point in a century. Economically, the inland relocation of factories and the destruction of the occupied areas set industrialisation back again; after the war inflation worsened, the reception of the liberated areas was chaotic, the United Front broke down and a full-scale civil war began, dragging the country into another long war. The question of Taiwan was settled in the same period: the Cairo Declaration of 1943 specified that Taiwan and the Pescadores were to be restored to China, and on 25 October 1945 Taiwan was recovered and its reception was run by Chen Yi; the police system and land questions left over from fifty years of Japanese rule later produced the incident of 2 February 1947. In world terms, China's protracted resistance was a main pillar of the Allied victory in the Pacific war; Japan after its surrender was occupied by the Allied powers, principally the United States, the East Asian order was rearranged, and the national liberation movements in colonies such as Vietnam and Indonesia accelerated.
result: 結果是日本無條件投降。1945年7月17日美、中、英三國發表《波茨坦宣言》，要求日本無條件投降，聲明保留日本天皇之尊位；8月6日美軍在廣島投下原子彈，8月8日蘇聯對日宣戰並於9日自西向東進入中國東北，8月10日日本政府表示接受宣言原則，15日天皇廣播詔書宣布接受《波茨坦宣言》；9月2日代表中、美、英、蘇的徐永昌與日本代表在密蘇里號戰艦上簽署《日本投降書》，戰爭以書面形式終結。9月9日蔣中正在南京受降典禮接受中國戰區日本方面軍最高司令官岡村寧次投降，中國恢復戰前失地，臺灣、澎湖重回中國版圖。勝利並不意味著統一：接收日軍裝備與美援使國軍裝備大幅膨脹，東北與關內的主權爭議在雅爾達密約中並未明文處理，國共之間的信任崩潰，1946年內戰重新開打，1949年政權在內戰中易手，抗戰所換來的是統一國家的形式而非統一的現實。
resultEn: The result was the unconditional surrender of Japan. On 17 July 1945 the United States, China and Britain issued the Potsdam Declaration demanding unconditional surrender while promising to preserve the status of the Emperor of Japan. On 6 August American forces dropped an atomic bomb on Hiroshima, on 8 August the Soviet Union declared war on Japan and on the 9th moved into Manchuria from the west, on 10 August the Japanese government indicated acceptance of the principles of the Declaration, and on the 15th the Emperor broadcast the rescript accepting the Potsdam Declaration. On 2 September Hsu Yung-chang, signing for China, the United States, Britain and the Soviet Union, and the Japanese representatives signed the Instrument of Surrender of Japan aboard the battleship Missouri, and the war ended in written form. On 9 September Chiang Kai-shek at the Nanjing ceremony accepted the surrender of Okamura Yasuji, commander in chief of the Japanese forces in the China Theatre, and China recovered its pre-war territories, with Taiwan and the Pescadores returning to the Chinese map. Victory did not mean unity: taking over Japanese equipment together with American aid greatly inflated the Nationalist army's stocks, the question of authority over Manchuria and the interior was not explicitly settled in the Yalta agreements, trust between the Kuomintang and the Communists collapsed, civil war resumed in 1946, and in 1949 the regime changed hands during that war. What the resistance bought was the form of a unified state rather than the reality of one.
